messages.author: 473c4ce8ca8f75f2
messages.subject: How to learn ggplot2 ?
parts:
Good morning all,

I am just starting with ggplot2, so I can't make detailed comments, although it looks good. 

I will have more comments on that, as I learn.

But I'd like to say how I learn, as I doubt I am alone.

What I would like to see is code built up, one command at a time, with accompanying graphs.  If the new code in each example is in a different font, that makes it even better.  But the most important things, to me, are lots and lots of examples, with annotated code.

I am very interested in getting better at ggplot2.   I am not a programmer (for some reason, I find programming very hard), i am a data analyst/statistician. 

Thanks to Hadley for writing a great program, and being so open and responsive.

And thanks to this list for helping us newbies out

Peter

Peter L. Flom, PhD
Statistical Consultant
www DOT peterflomconsulting DOT com

parts:
Hi Peter,

Just a quick note to let you know that as I work on the final version
of the book, I'm doing my best to ensure that every graph produced in
the plot has the code to create it nearby. It's not quite the level
of detail you want, but it should be helpful!

Hadley
